ICS 01.040.29; 29.240ETD 01Revised Standard from Last Update.NATIONAL FOREWORDThis Indian Standard (Part 70) ( First Revision) which is identical with IEC 60050-614 : 2016 ‘International electrotechnical vocabulary - Part 614: Generation, transmission and distribution of electricity - Operation’ issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the Basic Electrotechnical Standards and Power Quality Sectional Committee and approval of the Electrotechnical Division Council.This standard was first published in 1993. This revision has been undertaken to take into consideration the developments that have taken place subsequently and also to align with the latest version of IEC 60050-614 : 2016
